title: VLFeedback: A Large-Scale AI Feedback Dataset for Large Vision-Language Models Alignment
paper_type_zh: 大规模多模态 AI 反馈数据集与 VLM 对齐研究
best_for_zh: 研究视觉语言奖励模型、DPO 或 AI 反馈审计的读者
one_line: VLFeedback releases GPT-4V-scored multimodal responses across helpfulness, visual faithfulness, and ethical considerations for VLM preference training.
VLFeedback 用 GPT-4V 按有帮助性、视觉忠实性和伦理考量为多模态回答打分并生成理由，支持 VLM 偏好训练。
why: It exposes a scalable multimodal feedback contract while making judge agreement and failure modes inspectable.
inclusion_reason: Large public multimodal AI-feedback resource for VLM alignment with explicit scoring dimensions and human-agreement check.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-language alignment needs feedback on whether a response is useful, grounded in the image, and safe. Human multimodal annotation is costly, while prior datasets were smaller or focused on one dimension. A generic quality label cannot show whether an answer is fluent but visually hallucinated.

VLFeedback separates helpfulness, visual faithfulness, and ethical considerations. Each image instruction has several LVLM answers scored by GPT-4V with rationales, from which preference pairs are derived. It is public AI-feedback data, not human-ground-truth preference data.

视觉语言对齐需要判断回答是否有帮助、是否以图像为依据、是否安全。人类多模态标注昂贵，既有数据集规模更小或只关注单一维度。通用质量标签无法说明回答可能流畅却发生视觉幻觉。

VLFeedback 将判断拆为有帮助性、视觉忠实性和伦理考量。每条图像指令由多个 LVLM 回答，再由 GPT-4V 给分并提供理由，可从中导出偏好对。它是公开 AI 反馈数据，而非人类真实偏好金标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
VLFeedback scales VLM alignment through GPT-4V feedback. It curates diverse instructions, samples at least four answers from a 12-model pool, and rates each response from 1 to 5 with rationale on three dimensions. DPO pairs use average aspect score and discard ties. The contract is auditable AI judgment with explanations. Compared with narrow visual-faithfulness sets, it adds helpfulness and ethics at scale; human agreement is evidence for, not a replacement of, human review.

Official data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MMInstruction/VLFeedback. Code: https://github.com/vlf-silkie/VLFeedback.

VLFeedback 以 GPT-4V 反馈扩展 VLM 对齐。它整理多样指令，从 12 模型池抽取至少四个回答，并按三个维度以 1–5 分和理由评分。DPO 对使用平均维度分数构造，平局被丢弃。其契约是带解释、可审计的 AI 判断。相比狭窄的视觉忠实性数据，它在规模上加入有帮助性和伦理；人类一致性只是支持证据，不能替代人类审查。

官方数据：https://huggingface.co/datasets/MMInstruction/VLFeedback。代码：https://github.com/vlf-silkie/VLFeedback。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Curate general, academic, robustness, domain-specific, and red-teaming image instructions from source training splits.
  2. Randomly sample at least four responses per instruction from a 12-LVLM pool.
  3. Ask GPT-4V to rate each response on helpfulness, visual faithfulness, and ethics with a rationale.
  4. Derive pairwise DPO labels from average score and remove ties.
  5. Train Qwen-VL-Chat with DPO to make Silkie. Reproduce using the official data revision, model pool, prompts, score aggregation, and source-image rights audit.

1. 从源数据训练切分整理通用、学术、鲁棒性、领域专用和红队图像指令。
  2. 每条指令从 12 个 LVLM 池随机抽取至少四个回答。
  3. 请 GPT-4V 按有帮助性、视觉忠实性和伦理维度给分并写出理由。
  4. 按平均分导出 DPO 偏好对，丢弃平局。
  5. 用 DPO 训练 Qwen-VL-Chat 得到 Silkie。复现需固定官方数据版本、模型池、提示、分数聚合，并审计源图像权利。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports 82.4K instructions, 67K unique images, and 399.4K preference pairs. Human–GPT-4V agreement is 0.76 on a 200-comparison general subset and 0.71 on a 200-comparison red-team subset, close to human–human agreement of 0.76 and 0.69.

DPO-trained Silkie improves the base model by 6.9% on MME perception and 9.5% on cognition, and improves MMHal-Bench. The paper also documents GPT-4V mistakes from visual misjudgment or conflicting rationales, so agreement is not proof of universal label correctness.

论文报告 82.4K 条指令、67K 张独特图像和 399.4K 偏好对。在 200 对通用子集上，人类—GPT-4V 一致性为 0.76；在 200 对红队子集上为 0.71，接近人类—人类的 0.76 和 0.69。

DPO 训练的 Silkie 在 MME 感知与认知上相对基座分别提升 6.9% 和 9.5%，并改进 MMHal-Bench。论文也记录 GPT-4V 会因视觉误判或理由冲突产生错误标签，因此一致性不证明标签普遍正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier VLM preference data was smaller or concentrated on visual faithfulness. VLFeedback changes the feedback unit to three explicit aspects with GPT-4V rationales across broad image-instruction sources. The direction signal is scalable multimodal RLAIF with inspectable dimensions. Scale, human-agreement measurements, and released rationales are quality signals. It is not human RLHF, and GPT-4V does not eliminate annotation bias.
既有 VLM 偏好数据更小或集中于视觉忠实性。VLFeedback 将反馈单元改为跨广泛图像指令来源的三个明确维度和 GPT-4V 理由。其方向信号是具有可检查维度的可扩展多模态 RLAIF。规模、人类一致性测量和公开理由是质量信号；它不是人类 RLHF，GPT-4V 也不能消除标注偏差。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
GPT-4V may misread an image or provide a conflicting rationale. Audit examples, retain aspect scores, and compare with an independent judge or people before treating labels as reward truth.

Average score collapses conflicts between helpfulness, grounding, and ethics. Test aspect-specific rewards and inspect ties rather than assuming one winner meets every objective.

Images and source tasks have separate provenance. Verify rights, privacy, benchmark overlap, and red-team handling before redistribution or training.

GPT-4V 可能误读图像或给出冲突理由。将标签当作奖励真相前，应审计样本、保留维度分数，并与独立评审或人类比较。

平均分会压缩有帮助性、视觉依据和伦理之间的冲突。应测试维度特异奖励并检查平局，不能假定一个胜者满足所有目标。

图像和源任务有独立来源。再分发或训练前应核验权利、隐私、基准重叠和红队处理。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use VLFeedback to train or audit a VLM reward model or DPO pipeline with explicit grounding and safety checks. Input is image, instruction, candidate answers, scores, and rationales; action is aspect-specific analysis or pair construction. Success is better held-out multimodal quality without hiding hallucination or safety regression.

Do not use it as human-preference ground truth, a blanket license for source images, or a substitute for high-stakes human review.

可用 VLFeedback 训练或审计带显式视觉依据和安全检查的 VLM 奖励模型或 DPO 流水线。输入是图像、指令、候选回答、分数和理由；可做维度分析或构造配对。成功是在不掩盖幻觉或安全退化的前提下提升留出多模态质量。

不应将其当成人类偏好真相、源图像的一揽子许可证，或高风险人类审查的替代品。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep AI judgment distinct from human preference.
  2. Inspect all three aspects and rationales before averaging scores.
  3. Pin the HF dataset revision and audit source-image rights.
  4. Split by image and source task to control leakage.
  5. Validate reward-model gains with human or independent visual evaluation.

1. 将 AI 判断与人类偏好区分开。
  2. 平均分前检查三个维度和理由。
  3. 固定 HF 数据集版本并审计源图像权利。
  4. 按图像和源任务切分以控制泄漏。
  5. 用人类或独立视觉评估验证奖励模型增益。
